column2: It was built in effortless harmony with nature indeed!!
Yes, it is functional and remarkably free of waste.
But that also makes it feel cold!
Hey, are those the city's people over there?
Welcome to our city of Gomorrah!
Our companions in $$愛$$, the $$救世主$$'s party!!
I am $$ベルフェ$$, this city's representative!!
$$ケルビム$$ informed us; we have eagerly awaited your arrival!!
What do you think? Is Gomorrah not splendid?
Because everyone in this city works for the city,
Naturally, schools, hospitals, and all such facilities are free regardless of $$羽$$ color!
Come, this way! Allow me to show you around the city!!
